parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, border or police targeting is documented; bathroom access is recorded as protected and same-sex relations are legal. Resident LGR/medical procedures are climate only. The 2022 trans murder is a single incident whose 12-year sentence and rejected provocation claim show state prosecution, not impunity. Weaknesses are lack of hate-crime/hate-speech inclusion for gender identity, so no specific enhanced recourse, and a socially cautious climate: 61% accept trans identification and 75% support anti-discrimination, but LGBTIQ-wide (not trans-specific) avoidance/hiding indicators are high, suggesting friction/hostility above broad acceptance. Functioning courts and recent equality action plan partially mediate this, placing the jurisdiction in reduced-risk, below fully enforced-protection levels.
